description: Bounded parameters for tools/render_diff.py, the rasterised PDF comparison used by every 'behaviour unchanged' assertion.
pixel_diff_threshold_allowed_range: 0..255 (absolute 8-bit grayscale delta above which a pixel counts as different)
diff_ratio_tolerance_allowed_range: 0.0..1.0 (fraction of differing pixels on a page tolerated before the page is reported as different)
region_block_px_allowed_range: 4..64 (raster block edge used to group differing pixels into connected difference regions)
